summary: Deliverable is ~60% complete; critical files are missing. Workflow YAML is sound (pinned versions, correct permissions, good triggers), and artifact_cleanup.py has solid error handling and validation. However, the task explicitly requires TDD—write failing test FIRST—yet test_artifact_cleanup.py is absent. Fixture files (fixtures/sample_artifacts.json, fixtures/size_budget_artifacts.json) are also missing; the workflow references them but they don't exist. Without these, the workflow won't run and TDD compliance cannot be verified. Script quality: good structure, clean dataclasses, separate policy functions. Concerns: run_act_tests.py hard-codes job count (line ~38) and fixture content expectations; object identity tracking via id() (line ~100 in artifact_cleanup.py) is brittle. run_act_tests.py test expectations assume fixture data correctness without fixtures provided. Incomplete delivery of stated requirements.
